messages:
ava: Heads up 1: inbound routing SLA spike this morning. Some leads sat unassigned for >10m. Anyone saw the same?

diego: Saw it. ~55 leads unassigned between 03:10-03:30 UTC. Enrichment step returned 504s then HubSpot webhook marked them as failed.

priya: Confirmed — the enrichment worker pool was starved (OOM loop) and the retry policy was effectively off.

noah: SDRs reported extra manual claims. They flagged poor data on a few VIP leads. Not good.

ops-bot: ALERT: inbound_unassigned_count 55 (threshold 10) 2026-03-15 03:10-03:30 UTC

ava: Immediate mitigations: 1) enable minimal fallback routing using available HS props after 25s 2) enable 3x webhook retries with 8s backoff 3) tag fallback claims so reps know. Agree?

emma: Agreed. I'll draft the fallback tag and the HS banner copy. Short and clear: "Data may be incomplete, please verify before outreach."

priya: Config idea for HubSpot workflow (pseudo):
```json
{"workflow": "on_enrichment_timeout", "timeout_s": 25, "actions": [{"set":"enrichment_status","value":"timed_out"},{"trigger":"fallback_routing"}]}
```
No race with later updates if we only write status when empty.

diego: I'll implement the routing toggle `enable_enrich_fallback` behind a ff. Plan: run end-to-end in staging, then flip in prod during low traffic window.

noah: For transparency, add a queue label `fallback-enrichment` and a note in the lead view: `Enrichment timed out at 2026-03-15T03:15Z`. SDRs need this so they can be cautious.

priya: Also adding metrics: claim_rate by source, pct_fallback_claims, and avg_claim_latency. Will add alert if fallback_claims > 2% sustained.

ava: Who owns the rollout and the comms?

diego: I can own rollout + run the safety tests. ETA: 3 hours.

emma: I'll own SDR comms and update the KB article. Will include the two-sentence template and an example message reps can paste.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: enable_enrich_fallback -> staging by diego at 2166008000

diego: Staging pass: routing logic fallback works, tag appears, retries enabled. Running canary for 15m.

noah: Please include a backfill for leads that fell into limbo. Quick backfill SQL: 
```sql
UPDATE leads SET owner = rr_next_owner() WHERE owner IS NULL AND created_at > now()-interval '24 hours' AND enrichment_status IN ('timed_out','failed');
```
We'll run with a dry-run first.

ava: Good. Post-deploy checklist: monitor claim_rate, watch SDR Slack for complaints, verify no duplicate claims. If anomaly, flip ff off.

priya: I'll add automated Saturday smoke: assert claim_rate >= 95% and fallback_claims < 2%. If fail, auto-create INC ticket.

emma: Draft comms done. Short blurb to #sales in 10m with KB link and sample outreach.

diego: Rolling prod toggle now (maintenance window). Will report back in 10m.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: enable_enrich_fallback -> prod by diego at 2166008105

diego: Prod toggle on. Monitoring. First 10m: claim_rate improved, fallback_claims ~1.6%. No VIP complaints so far.

ava: Thanks all. Long term: increase enrichment worker headroom, add circuit breaker and exponential retries, and explore async enrichment with optimistic routing. We'll schedule for Q2 ops sprint.

noah: Adding a retro item: weekend canary job + oncall runbook update.

priya: Filing follow-ups: LEAD-1023 (parallelism), LEAD-1024 (retry policy), LEAD-1025 (KB updates).

emma: I posted the SDR note and pinned the KB. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/LEAD-SDR-KB

ava: Excellent. Closing thread. Thanks everyone.
